scheme_name: Mahila Samiriddhi Yojana for Backward Classes- Haryana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana
Applicant must have a Pariwar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID)
In a Self-Help Group, at least 60% of members must be from Backward Classes, with the remaining 40% allowed from other weaker sections such as SC, Handicapped, or Minorities
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to ₹1,25,000 per beneficiary to women entrepreneurs, either directly or via Self-Help Groups.
